name: Delivery Van · Round 1
domainSummary: A compact last-mile van defined by a tall enclosed cargo cube, a short forward cab, clear side and rear access zones, a stable commercial wheelbase, and unmarked slab panels.
evidenceBoundary: Keep the van generic and unowned. Do not imply carrier, package type, route, delivery state, cargo contents, or a real production model.

researchSources.title: Career World ambient expansion inventory
researchSources.use: Accepted delivery-van role and canonical map-scale baseline.

researchSources.title: Tournament production ledger
researchSources.use: Canonical delivery-van geometry and identity boundary.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Canonical Production
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop; emphasize tall enclosed cargo body
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested in its most resolved reusable form. This version emphasizes tall enclosed cargo body.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Silhouette Contrast
assets.controlledVariable: push the outer contour and negative spaces for instant recognition at map scale; emphasize short forward cab
assets.thesis: A distinct silhouette tests recognition without labels or color. This version emphasizes short forward cab.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Weighted Asymmetry
assets.controlledVariable: shift the dominant mass off-center while preserving the asset's practical balance; emphasize side and rear access zones
assets.thesis: Controlled asymmetry creates identity without sacrificing function. This version emphasizes side and rear access zones.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Functional Exposure
assets.controlledVariable: make the asset's defining working parts structurally legible without diagrams; emphasize stable commercial wheelbase
assets.thesis: Exposed function tests whether the object reads through construction rather than decoration. This version emphasizes stable commercial wheelbase.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Rugged Structure
assets.controlledVariable: strengthen load-bearing edges, joints, guards, and contact points; emphasize plain unmarked body panels
assets.thesis: Rugged construction tests a durable working-world interpretation. This version emphasizes plain unmarked body panels.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Modular Rhythm
assets.controlledVariable: organize repeated functional elements into a clear unequal rhythm on one coherent object or shared base; emphasize tall enclosed cargo body
assets.thesis: A modular cadence tests reuse and system belonging. This version emphasizes tall enclosed cargo body.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Low Profile
assets.controlledVariable: compress height and emphasize a long stable footprint while retaining every defining feature; emphasize short forward cab
assets.thesis: A low profile tests legibility in dense map placement. This version emphasizes short forward cab.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Vertical Accent
assets.controlledVariable: give one legitimate functional element a taller focal role while keeping the overall prop subordinate to buildings; emphasize side and rear access zones
assets.thesis: A vertical accent tests landmark readability without turning the prop into architecture. This version emphasizes side and rear access zones.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the asset to the smallest complete form that preserves its exact identity and component count; emphasize stable commercial wheelbase
assets.thesis: The primitive reveals which cues are essential. This version emphasizes stable commercial wheelbase.

assets.name: Delivery Van · Ambient Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance silhouette, function, construction, modular detail, and map-scale restraint in one production-ready prop; emphasize plain unmarked body panels
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests the complete ambient identity for repeated world use. This version emphasizes plain unmarked body panels.
